title: Can desalination solve the global water crisis?
speaker: DW Planet A
zh: 【DW Planet A】海水淡化能否解決全球水危機？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In 2015 a series of droughts started to dry up this dam,
cues.en: In 2015 a series of droughts started to dry up this dam,

cues.en: Cape Town was the first major city to risk running out of water, but it's not going to be the last.

cues.en: Jakarta, London, Beijing, Tokyo could all face their own day zero in the coming decades.

cues.text: “Most parts of the world at least for a month a year are experiencing some water stress or water scarecity."
cues.en: “Most parts of the world at least for a month a year are experiencing some water stress or water scarecity."
cues.zh: “世界上大部分地區每年至少有一個月的時間面臨著水資源緊張或水資源短缺的問題。”

cues.text: “The gap between demand and supply of water is narrowing down.”
cues.en: “The gap between demand and supply of water is narrowing down.”
cues.zh: “水的需求和供應之間的差距正在縮小。”

cues.text: Our planet is awash with water.
cues.en: Our planet is awash with water.
cues.zh: 我們的星球被水淹沒。

cues.text: More than one billion trillion liters to be precise.
cues.en: More than one billion trillion liters to be precise.
cues.zh: 準確地說，超過十億萬億公升。

cues.text: The problem is that 97% of Earth's water is salty and most of the freshwater is frozen in ice caps.
cues.en: The problem is that 97% of Earth's water is salty and most of the freshwater is frozen in ice caps.
cues.zh: 問題是地球上 97% 的水都是鹹水，而大部分淡水都凍結在冰蓋中。

cues.text: Less than 1% of the Earth's water is drinkable.
cues.en: Less than 1% of the Earth's water is drinkable.
cues.zh: 地球上只有不到 1% 的水可以飲用。

cues.text: That makes one solution especially promising: Desalination seems a pretty straight forward solution:
cues.en: That makes one solution especially promising: Desalination seems a pretty straight forward solution:
cues.zh: 這使得一個解決方案特別有前景：海水淡化似乎是一個非常簡單的解決方案：

cues.text: you take that undrinkable salt water, you remover the salt, and you have an unlimited supply of freshwater.
cues.en: you take that undrinkable salt water, you remover the salt, and you have an unlimited supply of freshwater.
cues.zh: 你喝了那些不能飲用的鹽水，去除了鹽分，你就得到了無限量的淡水。

cues.text: So, why are we not building more desalination plants?
cues.en: So, why are we not building more desalination plants?
cues.zh: 那麼，我們為什麼不建造更多的海水淡化廠呢？

cues.text: Desalination is a natural process that's been known for millennia.
cues.en: Desalination is a natural process that's been known for millennia.
cues.zh: 海水淡化是一種自然過程，已有數千年的歷史。

cues.text: As already Aristotle noted, the sun dissolves ocean water into vapor,
cues.en: As already Aristotle noted, the sun dissolves ocean water into vapor,
cues.zh: 正如亞里斯多德已經指出的那樣，太陽將海水溶解成蒸氣，

cues.text: which then condenses again and falls back as rain.
cues.en: which then condenses again and falls back as rain.

cues.en: His compatriots took note.

cues.en: Greek sailors boiled seawater for long trips.
cues.zh: 希臘水手在長途旅行時將海水煮沸。

cues.text: Romans used clay filters to trap salt.
cues.en: Romans used clay filters to trap salt.
cues.zh: 羅馬人使用黏土過濾器來捕獲鹽。

cues.text: These are still the two basic principles used today.
cues.en: These are still the two basic principles used today.
cues.zh: 這些仍然是今天使用的兩個基本原則。

cues.text: Thermal desalination uses heat.
cues.en: Thermal desalination uses heat.
cues.zh: 熱法海水淡化使用熱量。

cues.text: Salt's boiling point is a lot higher than water, so if you boil salt water,

cues.zh: 鹽的沸點比水高很多，所以如果你煮鹽水，

cues.en: only freshwater will evaporate, leaving all the salt behind.
cues.zh: 只有淡水會蒸發，留下所有的鹽。

cues.text: Membrane desalination uses pressure.
cues.en: Membrane desalination uses pressure.
cues.zh: 膜法海水淡化使用壓力。

cues.en: Saltwater, here colored in red for clarity, is pressed through a membrane that is only partially permeable.
cues.zh: 鹽水（為了清晰起見，這裡用紅色表示）被壓過僅部分滲透的膜。

cues.text: Freshwater can pass through, here colored in blue, but the salt is trapped on the other side.
cues.en: Freshwater can pass through, here colored in blue, but the salt is trapped on the other side.
cues.zh: 淡水可以透過，這裡呈現藍色，但鹽被困在另一邊。

cues.text: The technology didn't improve much until the 19th century, when industrialization and population growth encouraged more research.
cues.en: The technology didn't improve much until the 19th century, when industrialization and population growth encouraged more research.
cues.zh: 直到 19 世紀，工業化和人口成長鼓勵了更多的研究，這項技術才取得了很大進展。

cues.text: Today Cape Town is doing a lot better and the dam is almost full.
cues.en: Today Cape Town is doing a lot better and the dam is almost full.
cues.zh: 如今，開普敦的情況好多了，大壩幾乎滿了。

cues.text: The city was rushing to build desalination plants to avoid day zero.
cues.en: The city was rushing to build desalination plants to avoid day zero.
cues.zh: 該市正忙著建造海水淡化廠以避免「零日」。

cues.text: But the solution was not desalination or any other technology.
cues.en: But the solution was not desalination or any other technology.
cues.zh: 但解決方案不是海水淡化或任何其他技術。

cues.text: Citizens became water-wise.
cues.en: Citizens became water-wise.
cues.zh: 公民變得節水了。

cues.text: They radically changed their water use, and valued water for the essential and irreplaceable substance that it is.
cues.en: They radically changed their water use, and valued water for the essential and irreplaceable substance that it is.
cues.zh: 他們從根本上改變了用水方式，並重視水作為重要且不可替代的物質。

cues.text: Fun fact: The amount of desalinated water we produce every year is comparable to half the water that falls off the Niagara Falls every year.
cues.en: Fun fact: The amount of desalinated water we produce every year is comparable to half the water that falls off the Niagara Falls every year.
cues.zh: 有趣的事實：我們每年生產的淡化水量相當於尼加拉瀑布每年流下的水量的一半。

cues.text: That's it from us. As you can guess from this quick time-lapse, these videos take a lot of time. If you liked it, please give it some love.
cues.en: That's it from us. As you can guess from this quick time-lapse, these videos take a lot of time. If you liked it, please give it some love.
cues.zh: 這就是我們的。正如您從這段快速延時中可以猜到的那樣，這些影片需要花費很多時間。如果你喜歡它，請給它一些愛。

cues.text: Share, subscribe, press the like button.
cues.en: Share, subscribe, press the like button.
cues.zh: 分享、訂閱、按讚按鈕。

cues.text: And stay tuned. We have more videos like this coming out every Friday.
cues.en: And stay tuned. We have more videos like this coming out every Friday.
cues.zh: 請繼續關注。每週五我們都會發布更多這樣的影片。
